title: eludite/project/launchProfiles
description: A project's launch profiles from `Properties/launchSettings.json` (brief 0049; host-rpc.md, "Project properties"), for the Debug property page and the Debug toolbar's profile list. Read with System.Text.Json's nodes: the file's order and the members Eludite does not edit are kept. A missing file has no profiles (`exists` false). A file that is not JSON fails with -32602.

project.description: Absolute path of a project file of the open solution (`.csproj`, `.vbproj`, `.fsproj`), or the project file that is open as the solution.

generation.description: The generation the profiles were read under.

project.description: Absolute path of the project file.

file.description: Absolute path of `Properties/launchSettings.json` (it may not exist).

profiles.description: The profiles, in the file's order.

profile.description: One launch profile of `Properties/launchSettings.json`, in the file's order.

name.description: The profile's name (its member name under `profiles`).

commandName.description: Project (run the project), Executable (run `executablePath`), IISExpress, IIS, Docker, or another tool's kind, as written.

environmentVariables.description: The environment variables table, in the file's order.

launchBrowser.description: Open a browser on the site when the project starts.

launchUrl.description: The page to open, relative to the application URL, or absolute.

applicationUrl.description: The URLs the app listens on, `;`-separated.

executablePath.description: Executable profiles: the program to run.

readOnly.description: IIS Express (and IIS) profiles off Windows: listed read-only.

unknown.description: The names of members Eludite does not edit; they are kept as they are on every write.

environmentVariable.description: One environment variable, in the file's order.
